maria_ml: Quick sync on multivec-pooling onboarding. Baseline (heron-v2, single-pool fp32): r@1=0.71 r@5=0.88 MRR=0.64 silhouette=0.09. multivec-axial (3-chunk mean pool, fp32) r@1=0.58 r@5=0.86 MRR=0.52 silhouette=0.02 /

sam_s: Wow r@1 drop is big. Are you indexing as single-vector (agg) or using multi-vector HNSW?

maria_ml: Both. For multi-vector we store 3 vectors per doc and do max-sim over chunks at query time; HNSW efSearch=128. Even with true multi-vector retrieval r@1 only 0.62, MRR 0.56. Short queries still worst.

june_p: Could be pooling mismatch. Was the training objective chunked? Maybe model learned locality per chunk but mean pooling collapses. Any UMAPs?

maria_ml: UMAPs show topical clusters smeared; per-doc variance increases. Example: long FAQ with strong anchor token now splits across chunks, top chunk matches noisy boilerplate.

sam_s: Try two quick things: 1) whiten/PCA on per-chunk vectors before aggregation (removes dominant directions). 2) L2-normalize each chunk then max-pool instead of mean. Often recovers anchors.

maria_ml: Kicking both. Also comparing cosine vs dot for ranking (we used dot earlier).

ci-bot: run embed-bakeoff/multivec-pool-1791012345 started by maria_ml at 1791012355

ci-bot: finished -> summary: fp32 agg-mean-dot: r@1=0.58 r@5=0.86 MRR=0.52 silhouette=0.02; fp32 chunk-norm-max + PCA-whiten: r@1=0.67 r@5=0.89 MRR=0.60 silhouette=0.065. Notebook: https://ci.internal/notebooks/multivec-1791012345

june_p: Nice recovery with normalized-max + PCA. Any quant runs (ONNX int8)?

maria_ml: Ran ONNX int8 post-train on the improved pipeline: int8 r@1=0.64 r@5=0.87 MRR=0.58  a small hit but acceptable given latency improvements.

sam_s: If int8 still weak on some anchors, try per-channel quant and quant-bias folding. Also experiment with slightly higher efSearch for multi-vector queries (128->256) to reduce index recall noise.

maria_ml: Plan: 1) adopt chunk-norm-max + PCA whitening for onboarding doc, 2) schedule per-channel int8 + efSearch sweep, 3) add multivec shortquery microbench to weekly bakeoff. Reverting prod pin to heron-v2 until we meet parity.

devbot: Ticket ML-1930 "multivec axial: pooling+PCA recovery + int8 efSearch sweep" created and assigned to maria_ml

maria_ml: Will add the evaluation notebook and example id-flips to model-onboard. Thanks :thumbsup:
